import sys
j=open('/app/repo/data/project_photo.jpg','rb').read()
# parse
i=2
dht={}; sof=None; sos=None; scan=None
while i<len(j)-1:
    assert j[i]==0xff, hex(i)
    m=j[i+1]
    if m==0xd8: i+=2; continue
    ln=int.from_bytes(j[i+2:i+4],'big')
    seg=j[i+4:i+2+ln]
    if m==0xc4:
        k=0
        while k<len(seg):
            tc_th=seg[k]; k+=1
            counts=seg[k:k+16]; k+=16
            n=sum(counts)
            syms=seg[k:k+n]; k+=n
            dht[tc_th]=(list(counts),list(syms))
    elif m in (0xc0,0xc1):
        sof=seg
    elif m==0xda:
        sos=seg
        scan=j[i+2+ln:]
        break
    i+=2+ln
# build huffman decode tables: dict (len,code)->sym
dec={}
for tid,(counts,syms) in dht.items():
    t={}; code=0; p=0
    for l in range(1,17):
        for _ in range(counts[l-1]):
            t[(l,code)]=syms[p]; p+=1; code+=1
        code<<=1
    dec[tid]=t
# sof
prec=sof[0]; H=int.from_bytes(sof[1:3],'big'); W=int.from_bytes(sof[3:5],'big')
ncomp=sof[5]
comps=[]
for c in range(ncomp):
    cid=sof[6+3*c]; samp=sof[7+3*c]
    comps.append({'id':cid,'h':samp>>4,'v':samp&15})
# sos
ns=sos[0]
ctab=[]
for c in range(ns):
    cid=sos[1+2*c]; tt=sos[2+2*c]
    ctab.append((cid, tt>>4, tt&15))
# bit reader with FF00 unstuffing, skip restart markers
data=scan
pos=0; bitbuf=0; bitcnt=0
def nextbyte():
    global pos
    b=data[pos]; pos+=1
    if b==0xff:
        n=data[pos]
        if n==0x00: pos+=1; return b
        elif 0xd0<=n<=0xd7: pos+=1; return nextbyte()
        else: raise Exception('marker in scan %x'%n)
    return b
def getbit():
    global bitbuf,bitcnt
    if bitcnt==0:
        bitbuf=nextbyte(); bitcnt=8
    bitcnt-=1
    return (bitbuf>>bitcnt)&1
def getbits(n):
    v=0
    for _ in range(n): v=(v<<1)|getbit()
    return v
def huff(tid):
    code=0; l=0
    t=dec[tid]
    while l<16:
        code=(code<<1)|getbit(); l+=1
        if (l,code) in t: return t[(l,code)]
    raise Exception('bad huff')
def receive_extend(s):
    if s==0: return 0
    v=getbits(s)
    if v < (1<<(s-1)): v -= (1<<s)-1
    return v
# mcus
mx=max(c['h'] for c in comps); my=max(c['v'] for c in comps)
mcux=(W+8*mx-1)//(8*mx); mcuy=(H+8*my-1)//(8*my)
dc=[0]*ncomp
coefs=[]  # list per block: [dc] + ac in zigzag scan order
for myy in range(mcuy):
    for mxx in range(mcux):
        for ci,(cid,td,ta) in enumerate(ctab):
            c=comps[cid-1]
            for by in range(c['v']):
                for bx in range(c['h']):
                    s=huff(td<<4 | td)  # dc table id = td (tc=0 -> tid = td)
                    # actually dht keys: tc<<4|th; DC tc=0
                    blk=[]
                    diff=receive_extend(s)
                    dc[cid-1]+=diff
                    blk.append(dc[cid-1])
                    k=1
                    while k<64:
                        rs=huff((1<<4)|ta)
                        r=rs>>4; ss=rs&15
                        if ss==0:
                            if r==15: 
                                blk.extend([0]*16); k+=16; continue
                            else:
                                break
                        k+=r
                        v=receive_extend(ss)
                        blk.append(v); k+=1
                    coefs.append(blk)
print('blocks',len(coefs),'first blk',coefs[0][:10], file=sys.stderr)
import pickle
pickle.dump(coefs, open('/tmp/coefs.pkl','wb'))
